summary: Browser coverage for Iter16 is done. All writes went to clones: TEST_ page clones, and TEST_settings/TEST_revisions collections reached through the real in-process routes_admin.site_live_patch via a Playwright bridge. Fingerprints of the real theatre, craft-livelihood, home and connect pages and of the site settings were identical before and after. The real phone is still ''. (1) /app/tests/iter16_theatre_craft_delete_move.py: 43/43 PASS after an environment fix and one test-timing fix. That covers Theatre public link removal, grey rules gone with red accents kept, seeded clone link delete/undo/redo/save, deleting heading/body/image/eyebrow one at a time, whole-section cancel/confirm/undo, homepage Explore link delete staying gone on public, Craft blank-area click selecting the text field, nudges moving one field only, heading/image drag independence, field-level saved styles, public geometry matching the editor, and whole-section reorder. (2) New /app/tests/iter16_contact_card_site_text.py: 38/40 PASS. Covered: email/address/phone/form-label clicks open the Site text panel; multiline address persists and shows publicly; the Add phone number slot shows in the editor only and the saved phone gets href tel:+919810012345; a blank phone hides the row; the email href updates; the card has no contenteditable; clicking the blank card selects it and the selector shows |_contact_card; width 900/1100 and height 1500/520 via inputs; E/S handles resize; saved to the clone DB; public desktop size equals the editor's (1000x700); at 768/390 the height is auto, width is constrained and there is no horizontal overflow; form/address/email unchanged; empty and invalid-email validation work with no POST sent. 2 FAILS share one product bug: a short card height does not scroll inside, so the content spills out and the public Send button ends up under the site footer. No React page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: When the card height is shorter than its content (e.g. 520 or 700px on desktop), the content spills out of the white card instead of scrolling inside it (scrollHeight 873 > clientHeight 700, computed overflow 'visible'). On the public page the Send message button sits below the card bottom (button bottom 1026 vs card bottom 881) and elementFromPoint hits the site footer, so the user cannot click the submit button.

design_issues.screen: Live editor inspector for White contact card
issues: The 'Size & position' <details> group (data-testid=live-group-layout) is collapsed by default, but size is the only thing you can edit on this layout-only card and the hint says 'use Size & position below'. Consider open={isLayout} for _contact_card.

After a heading drag the inline style adds place-self:flex-start start, so the heading box narrows from 552 to 514px. The text still looks fine. Minor: if the box must stay full width, keep justify-self stretch.

action_items: Fix Blocks.jsx layoutStyle() line 38: `if (!isImageField(field)) o.overflow = "visible"` writes inline overflow:visible !important, which overrides boxed-layout.css `.pcc-card[style*="--ed-h"] { overflow: auto !important }` because inline !important beats stylesheet !important. Use o.overflow = field === "_contact_card" ? "auto" : "visible" (mobile already sets height:auto and overflow:visible via the <=960px rule, so check that still wins, or move it to the stylesheet). Then re-run /app/tests/iter16_contact_card_site_text.py: 'CT short height -> inner scroll' and 'CT short card ... submit button not covered' should pass.

Fix the dev hot-reload watcher. craco.config.js watchOptions.ignored contains "**/public/**", which matches src/components/public/** and src/pages/public/**, so edits to all public components and editor files are NOT recompiled. The served bundle still had the old Blocks.jsx (`it.link_label || ...`, no `!home || it.link_label !== ""` guard), so the homepage Explore link deleted in the DB still showed publicly. Narrow it to path.resolve(__dirname, 'public') or '**/frontend/public/**'. I restarted the frontend once to load the current sources; any later edits under components/public need a restart until this is fixed.
Optional: open the Size & position group by default when _contact_card is selected.
critical_code_review_comments: craco watchOptions.ignored '**/public/**' silently disables hot reload for every file under src/components/public and src/pages/public. This is high risk: the main agent may believe fixes are live when they are not. Earlier smoke results may have run against stale code.
layoutStyle() forces overflow visible for every non-image field with a height, including the layout-only _contact_card container. Container fields need overflow:auto.
LiveEditor.jsx is very large (>700 lines). Consider splitting the inspector panels.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run scripts with: cd /app && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend:$(/root/.venv/bin/python -c 'import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])') /opt/plugins-venv/bin/python3 tests/<script>.py. Both scripts isolate writes: page /live and public/pages are rerouted to clones; /api/admin/site-live is bridged to the in-process site_live_patch with db proxied to TEST_ collections; /api/public/site gets contact/ui_text/text_styles overlaid from the clone; any other non-GET is aborted. If behaviour looks stale, check the served bundle (curl localhost:3000/static/js/bundle.js) because of the craco ignore bug. Remaining fail: contact card short-height overflow.
rca of the issue: 1) Homepage Explore came back: the code was correct but the webpack dev watcher ignored src/components/public/** (craco '**/public/**'), so the bundle served an old RelatedWork that used `it.link_label || default` with no blank guard. A frontend restart fixed the served bundle. 2) Contact card short height: Blocks.jsx layoutStyle sets inline overflow:visible !important when there is a height, which beats the CSS overflow:auto !important. Content overflows, and the submit button lands under #site-footer. Reproduce: select the white card, set Height 700, save, open public /connect at 1920px, and try to click Send message. 3) The initial Craft public-geometry mismatch was a test flaw: the section was measured before the scroll-reveal transforms ran (translateY plus an image translateX of -46px). Scrolling into view first fixes it, and the geometry matches within 2px.
